# Attack replay results

**30 of 30 attacks from the Burp Suite test script behaved as expected against the running production stack.** Generated by `scripts/attack-replay.js` on 2026-11-09, over real HTTPS through Caddy, against the encrypted two-process stack.

**This replay is automated and did not go through Burp Suite.** It sends the same requests as [BURP-TEST-SCRIPT.md](BURP-TEST-SCRIPT.md), but it only checks the listed attacks; a person using Burp may try things that are not listed.

| # | Attack | Expected | Actual | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Three wrong passwords, then the right one | 401 every time | 401, 401, 401, 401 | Pass |
| 2 | 25 wrong sign-ins for different usernames | 429 after about 20 | 12 x 401, then 13 x 429 | Pass |
| 3 | Change the session cookie's value | 401 | 401 not_signed_in | Pass |
| 4 | Token with alg none and no signature | 401 | 401 not_signed_in | Pass |
| 5 | Replay a request after signing out | 401 | 401 not_signed_in | Pass |
| 6 | Password only, skipping the authenticator step | 401 | 401 not_signed_in | Pass |
| 7 | Reuse an authenticator code | 401 | 401 mfa_failed | Pass |
| 8 | Waiter opens users, audit log and sales report | 403, and an audit entry | 403, 403, 403; logged: true | Pass |
| 9 | Waiter takes a payment | 403 | 403 forbidden | Pass |
| 10 | Waiter B edits Waiter A's order | 404 | 404 not_found | Pass |
| 11 | Cashier opens an older bill | 404 | 404 not_found | Pass |
| 12 | Kitchen snapshot searched for prices and phone numbers | Neither appears | 200; found: false | Pass |
| 13 | Manager refunds with no recent authenticator code | 403 step_up_required | 403 step_up_required | Pass |
| 14 | Manager approves their own large refund | 403 same_person | 403 same_person (request 202) | Pass |
| 15 | Add total or price to an order | 400 | 400, 400 | Pass |
| 16 | Quantity of -5, 0, 1.5, 100 and "1" | 400 each time | 400, 400, 400, 400, 400 | Pass |
| 17 | NoSQL operators in the sign-in form | 401 | 401 sign_in_failed | Pass |
| 18 | Cashier applies a 50% discount | 403, and an audit entry | 403 discount_limit; entries 4 to 5 | Pass |
| 19 | Resend the same Idempotency-Key and body | The first result, and no second record | 201, 201; orders: 1 | Pass |
| 20 | Resend that key with a different body | 422 | 422 idempotency_conflict | Pass |
| 21 | Script in a guest's name | Stored as plain text, and the page policy forbids inline script | 201; JSON response; inline script forbidden | Pass |
| 22 | Remove the CSRF token | 403 | 403 bad_csrf | Pass |
| 23 | Change Origin to another site | 403 | 403 bad_origin | Pass |
| 24 | Remove the Origin header | 403 | 403 bad_origin | Pass |
| 25 | Check response headers | CSP with no unsafe-inline, DENY, nosniff | frame DENY; nosniff | Pass |
| 26 | HTML uploaded as a PNG | 415, and recorded | 415 bad_file; logged: true | Pass |
| 27 | SVG upload | 415 | 415 bad_file | Pass |
| 28 | Upload over 2 MB | 413 | 413 too_large | Pass |
| 29 | Payment callback with no signature | 401, and recorded | 401 bad_signature; logged: true | Pass |
| 30 | Correct signature sent twice | 204, then 409 | 204, 409 replayed | Pass |
